# FunderMaps

> FunderMaps is a Dutch geospatial platform for foundation-risk assessment of buildings. It ingests cadastral data (BAG), subsidence measurements and 3DBAG, runs a risk model over ~11.2M Dutch buildings, and surfaces the results to clients (insurers, banks, mortgage lenders, municipalities, surveyors) through a webservice, a customer app and PDF reports.

This site is the Dutch-language marketing front for FunderMaps. The product itself lives at separate subdomains (linked under "Apps").

## Primary pages

- [Home / Inzicht in funderingsrisico's](https://fundermaps.com/index.html): Hero, services overview, references, demo, partners.
- [Funderingstypes & risico's](https://fundermaps.com/media-library.html): Visual reference of foundation types (rotterdamse fundering, betonpaal, kespen, etc.) and their associated risks.
- [Meer informatie](https://fundermaps.com/more-info.html): Background on the dataplatform, how it works, and what information it surfaces.
- [Artikelen](https://fundermaps.com/artikelen.html): Articles on funderingsproblematiek — causes, repair, municipal policy, practical guidance.
- [Apps overzicht](https://fundermaps.com/apps.html): Index of FunderMaps apps and tools (maps, dashboard, admin, analytics) plus repair/registration helpers.

## Apps & tools (sub-products)

- [QuickScan](https://fundermaps.com/apps-quickscan.html): Standardised KCAF method that gives a quick foundation-risk indication from façade measurements, without invasive investigation.
- [Indicatieve herstelkosten](https://fundermaps.com/apps-herstelkosten.html): KCAF Herstelkostencalculator — first-cut repair-cost estimate by foundation type, repair method and building size.
- [Nationaal Funderingsherstel Register](https://fundermaps.com/nationaal-herstelregister.html): Public register for completed foundation-repair work, supporting taxation, transactions and policy.

## External product surfaces

- [FunderMaps Maps](https://maps.fundermaps.com/): Interactive map viewer.
- [FunderMaps App](https://app.fundermaps.com/): Customer dashboard for inquiries, recoveries, samples.
- [FunderMaps Admin](https://admin.fundermaps.com/): Admin console for FunderMaps staff.
- [FunderMaps Analytics](https://analytics.fundermaps.com/): Dashboards built on the FunderMaps dataset.
